description: GuardDuty Extended Threat Detection now identifies specific AI resources involved in credential-compromise attack sequences. AI Protection findings (Impact:IAMUser/AnomalousModelInvocation, Impact:IAMUser/CostHarvesting, Impact:IAMUser/PromptInjection.Direct) correlate with other credential-compromise signals into AttackSequence:IAM/CompromisedCredentials findings, which now include Bedrock models, SageMaker endpoints, and Bedrock guardrails in the resource list — giving you actionable context about which AI resources a stolen credential accessed and whether a Bedrock guardrail intervened. To maximize detection coverage, enable Bedrock AI Protection alongside GuardDuty. This feature is available in commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions.
